notes.title: World Without Reason - Final Story Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862944/ebc0058e0b59286f32bc9f1518d7f6c2dda64778.png
Two years ago I began conceptualizing the story for what would eventually become "World Without Reason"

After spending 24 months living the life of a hermit, hunkered down at my computer, pouring every last bit of spare energy into this project, I'm pleased to say that my vision for this game has been realized.

As someone who has been interested in game design since at least the 1st grade, I am grateful to have been given this amazing opportunity to work on a passion project which turned my paper drawings and word docs into a fully playable and complete game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862944/5d0e5a6999bcf26998756ab4503e22bf0585a809.png

Friends and family might recognize a few characters from way back when. It's been a long time coming, especially for my parents, who have been patiently waiting almost two decades for me to actually finish writing one of my many stories.

In some ways, this game is a unification of the stories I'd been writing since Middle School. In other ways, it's a reset/rebirth of an expansive 20-year narrative which had gotten too twisted for its own good.

Seeing my mom cry at the end of WWR's base game made me realize how much this game meant to her.

Of course, World Without Reason wasn't a solo-man effort. I've had the help of some majorly talented individuals.

To the artists who I've worked with throughout WWR's development, thank you for lending your talents to this project!


 Luna Raydue - Voice of Ashley Audacity
 Vera Tan - Voice of Xandra Prime
 Alyssa Moran - Voice of Alexandra Audacity
 Jerron Bacat - Voice of Avon Lancaster
 Nate Fernandez - Voice of Edmond Willson
 Juwan Royal - Voice of Abraham Huckley
 Lindsey Vachon - Voice of The Ultimate Secret
 Asahina Chie - Voice of Lana Yang
 Bell Kalengar - Composer of the OST
 vally.exe - Songwriter and Vocalist


Bell and vally did an amazing job with the end credits song. When I first contacted them about writing and composing the song, it was little more than an idea inside my head, but they worked their magic to bring it into reality. I implore you to follow them on YouTube and Twitter, and check out their other works!

Bell Kalengar:

 https://youtube.com/@bellkalengar7412
 https://x.com/BKalengar

vally.exe:

 https://youtube.com/@vallyexe
 https://x.com/vallyutaite


This bonus chapter “Mire” takes place after the events of the base game, and acts as a segue into the sequel: The Mire of Miss Audacity, which is currently in its planning stages. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44862944/339ea6c98d2a8bdaaeba13bb3e3da80bcc3d13c5.png

From the first comment I got on Itchio, to the first review I received on Steam, thank you for all the positive feedback. I hope you enjoy this new story segment.

Please look forward to my next game!


-Bamboo Calculator
